s01: Hello! I am Kuya Gas! (pause) Today you learn two big skills. (pause) First, how to follow directions. (pause) Second, how to ask questions!
actions: These are action words. (pause) Tap each one. (pause) Then do the action!
simon-how: Let us play Simon Says! (pause) If I say, Simon says, (pause) do the action. (pause) If I do not say Simon says, (pause) stay still! (pause) Listen carefully!
simon: Stand up! Ready? (pause) Listen to each one. (pause) Then tap what you did.
qwords: Now, question words! (pause) We use them to ask. (pause) Tap each one.
qwords-1: Who. (pause) Who is for a person. (pause) Who is your friend?
qwords-2: What. (pause) What is for a thing. (pause) What is your toy?
qwords-3: Where. (pause) Where is for a place. (pause) Where is your school?
qmatch: Which question word do we use? (pause) Listen and tap!
qmatch-q1: When we ask about a person, we say...
qmatch-q1-yes: Yes! Who is for a person.
qmatch-q2: When we ask about a place, we say...
qmatch-q2-yes: Yes! Where is for a place.
qmatch-q3: When we ask about a thing, we say...
qmatch-q3-yes: Yes! What is for a thing.
k1: Story time! (pause) Listen, and think of questions. (pause) This is Katkat. (pause) He is a little orange kitten. (pause) He lives near the beach.
k2: On Saturday morning, Katkat looks for his ball. (pause) His ball has a bell. (pause) Oh no! (pause) It is missing! (pause) Where is it?
k3: Katkat looks in the garden, near the mango tree. (pause) A white kitten has his ball! (pause) She gives it back. (pause) Now they are friends!
ask-story: Let us ask questions about the story. (pause) Listen to each question!
ask-story-q1-yes: Yes! The story is about Katkat.
ask-story-q2-yes: Yes! He lost his ball with a bell.
ask-story-q3: Where did Katkat find his ball?
ask-story-q3-yes: Yes! In the garden, near the mango tree.
ask-friend: Now you ask! (pause) Tap a question. (pause) Then ask someone at home.
ask-friend-3: Where do you want to go?
talk: Now answer a question. (pause) What is your favorite toy? (pause) Say: My favorite toy is my ball.
talk-example: My favorite toy is my ball.
verse: Our Bible verse is, (pause) Train up a child in the way he should go. (pause) We listen to our parents and teachers. (pause) That is how we grow!
verse-verse: Train up a child in the way he should go. (pause) Proverbs twenty-two, verse six.
done: Hooray! (pause) You followed directions. (pause) You learned who, what and where. (pause) And you asked questions about Katkat. (pause) See you tomorrow!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
fx-doit-1: Simon said it! Let us do it!
